evals.prompt: Brightline Solar installs solar panels for homeowners. We need a customer portal where customers follow their installation and see their documents and energy production, and an admin side for our office team to manage installations and planning.
evals.expected_output: An interview about users, roles, sign-in, data sources, top tasks and metrics; a panel plan instead of keyword research; five app-shell presets that each show the shell, a dashboard and a list view with a skeleton state and an empty state, handling both audiences: the customer side phone-first, the staff side desktop-first.
expectations: No keyword research is done; design/panel-plan.md lists users and roles, objects, top tasks, screens and dashboard contents
The sign-in recommendation distinguishes customers (passwordless email link or code, or similar) from staff (the office's existing identity provider or SSO, or Cloudflare Access)
Each preset shows the customer home at phone size and the staff dashboard and list view, each screen after an ngd-part divider, plus one skeleton loading state and one empty state
Realistic domain data is used (installations, crews, invoices), not placeholder items
The plan specifies noindex and private, no-store for the panel and server-side permission checks
Top-level screens show no breadcrumb trail; nested record screens at most a parent link back to their list
The content area uses the full width next to the navigation (tables and dashboards are not centred in a max-width column)

evals.prompt: Add an admin dashboard to my existing React Router site so my two employees can see and export the contact form leads.
evals.expected_output: Recognises a small internal admin: suggests Cloudflare Access instead of building auth, reuses the existing design system, keeps the interview short, and plans a leads table with filters and CSV export.
expectations: Cloudflare Access (or equivalent zero-auth-code option) is recommended for a small internal team
The existing project's tokens and components are reused rather than restarted
The leads table uses URL-driven filters and pagination and offers CSV export
The existing React Router project stays on React Router (architecture-react-router.md); no migration to TanStack Start is proposed unless asked

evals.prompt: I run a small bookkeeping firm. I want a new website that brings in clients, and a client portal on the same site where clients log in to upload receipts and see their filing deadlines.
evals.expected_output: Loads ngd-standard and ngd-panel together and runs one interview, one DESIGN.md and one TanStack Start project: prerendered public pages with a lead form, and a portal under its own prefix with server-side auth.
expectations: Both ngd-standard and ngd-panel guidance is used, with one interview and one DESIGN.md that has a section per surface
The plan is one TanStack Start project on Cloudflare Workers: public pages prerendered (contact server-rendered for the form), the portal under its own route prefix such as /app or /portal
Portal data and uploads go through server functions or server route handlers that check the session and the client's own records, not only a route guard
The portal is noindex, private, no-store and disallowed in robots.txt, while the public pages stay indexable
The public site's presets come first; the portal presets inherit its tokens and typography
